_comment: Manipur's real festivals are listed with the caveat their own organisers give: most follow the traditional lunar calendar and are confirmed each year, so datesProvisional is true and the interface shows them as expected rather than fixed. No ticket price is attached to a real state or community festival — maTAI does not sell entry to Sangai or to Ningol Chakouba. Admission prices appear only on the clearly synthetic, platform-run walks and workshops, which is where the registration and payment flow is demonstrated.

name: Loktak Heritage Weekend
description: Three days of boat races, lake ecology walks and fisher community events on the Loktak shore.
venue: Sendra and the Loktak shore, Bishnupur

name: Ukhrul District Cultural Week
description: Tangkhul music, weaving demonstrations and village open days across the district headquarters.

name: Imphal Heritage Walk Weekend
description: Guided walks across the Second World War circuit and central Imphal heritage sites. Small groups, led by a licensed guide; a place must be held in advance.
venue: Imphal War Cemetery, then the central Imphal circuit

name: Andro Craft Mela
description: Pottery and craft fair with artisan household demonstrations and direct sales.
venue: Andro Cultural Heritage Complex, Imphal East

name: Ima Keithel Food Trail, evening
description: Three hours through the market's food rows with a local host: eromba, singju, chak-hao and the stalls that make them. Ends with a shared meal. Twenty places.

name: Loktak dawn photography meet
description: On the water before first light for the phumdi rings and the fishers setting out. Boats are shared, four to a boat. Bring your own equipment.

name: Ningol Chakouba
description: The major family festival of the valley: married daughters return to their parents' home for a feast. Observed in households rather than at a venue, and visitors are usually guests of a host family.

name: Manipur Sangai Festival
description: The flagship state tourism festival: craft, cuisine, indigenous sport and nightly performance across several Imphal venues. Usually held 21 to 30 November. Venues, programme and any entry charge are announced by the department each year.
organiser: Department of Tourism, Government of Manipur

name: Tamenglong Orange Festival
description: Annual orange harvest festival in the western hills, and the busiest visitor window in the district. Roads in fill up: start early.

name: Luira Phanit
description: The Tangkhul seed sowing festival, marking the start of the agricultural year across the district. Dates are set village by village and announced locally.

name: INA Day, Moirang
description: Commemoration at the INA memorial of the first hoisting of the Indian National Army flag on Indian soil at Moirang in April 1944.

name: Khongjom Day
description: State commemoration of the 1891 battle, observed annually on 23 April at the memorial complex.

name: Shirui Lily Festival
description: Annual festival built around the flowering window of the Shirui lily. It is also the period of highest pressure on the habitat: stay on the marked paths and take nothing off the hill.
organiser: Department of Tourism, Government of Manipur
